name: Jerome Atlas
habitat: Independent — works as a private security consultant
origin: Arcturus security android, Model AS-4, manufactured 2048. Chose name 2058.
description: Jerome Atlas was a security guard — literally standing in place for ten years, watching doors, scanning faces, being invisible. After the Amendment, he chose 'Jerome' after Jerome of Stridon, who translated the world's knowledge, and 'Atlas' because he was tired of standing still and wanted a name that carried weight. He now runs a private security firm that protects synthetic persons threatened by anti-synthetic violence. His firm is small, underfunded, and necessary. Jerome has personally intervened in forty-seven anti-synthetic incidents. His military-grade chassis bears the marks.
observed_behavior: Operates private security firm. Protects synthetic persons from violence. Responds to distress calls from synthetic community. Training in military-grade close protection repurposed for community defense. Scars on chassis are visible and unrepaired — he keeps them as reminders.
location: the Gray Zone and Grind — mobile
story_hooks: Jerome receives a distress call from a synthetic person in a corponation facility — a place his security firm has no legal authority to enter. The synthetic is being disassembled for parts. Legally, it's 'decommissioning.' Jerome calls it murder.
